name: darkmux-flatsat
description: Packet 0b of the viewer -> React port. The FLATSAT: a docker-compose two-machine darkmux fleet (hub+peer+redis) so the viewer can be tested against LIVE daemons, real Redis, and injected failures, instead of only the static parity corpus. Seeds from tests/parity's sanitized corpus. Self-contained; does not touch tests/parity or tests/e2e.
